title: TOTP 2FA with recovery codes
summary: Local public accounts can protect sign-in with an authenticator app (one-time codes) and one-time recovery codes. Setup confirms before enable; enrolled accounts face a second step after password at Public Login. Disable and recovery-code refresh require recent password confirmation, with security emails on enable and disable.
changes: Add authenticator-app enrolment on the local profile: scan a QR code (or use the otpauth link), save recovery codes once, and confirm with a one-time code before the feature turns on.
Challenge enrolled local accounts with an authenticator or recovery code after a successful password at Public Login.
Hash recovery codes at rest, encrypt the authenticator secret, invalidate each recovery code after one successful use, and allow regenerating codes after password confirmation.
Disable authenticator sign-in after password confirmation and email the account when authenticator sign-in is enabled or disabled.
Leave Cloudron OIDC-only staff sign-in unchanged; authenticator enrolment stays local-password accounts only.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: custom TOTP 2FA after secure email change (0.39.4).
validation: PHPUnit TotpTwoFactorTest, StepUpAuthTest, SecureEmailChangeTest, AuthEmailBrandKitTest, PasswordPolicyHardeningTest.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Passkeys remain a later Account security wave; this release does not add WebAuthn.
Authenticator enrolment is not offered for Cloudron OIDC-only staff accounts.
Requiring 2FA for administrator local accounts is deferred.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Two-factor columns on users become unused after rollback and can remain null without blocking sign-in.
